address: Avenida Marquês De Pombal 5, Paço de Arcos, 2770-066, Portugal
bio: This modest yet charming restaurant opposite the Paço de Arcos gardens is characterised by great enthusiasm, painstaking service and the hard work of young Annakaren Fuentes, who is on top of everything. The cooking here can be defined as modern Portuguese, based around respect for traditional ingredients and flavours, showcased in one tasting menu, entitled Cabal (7 courses). Individual dishes can also be ordered à la carte....
